regime_context: US thematic leadership is bifurcated: AI Infrastructure ranks #1 but is only modestly durable (0.68) and fading, while Cybersecurity ranks #2 with very high durability (0.85), full breadth (1.0), and strong trend, but is crowded. The absolute-trend gate is validated (gate_helps=true) and the rotation breadth is narrowing (39% eligible, view='narrowing'), so this is a trend-discipline, vol-aware regime, not a return-forecasting one.
emerging_watch: Watch whether Cybersecurity's crowding (z=1.8) resolves by CIBR making a new 60-day high relative to SMH WITHOUT a spike in its crowding_z above 2.2 — a clean new-high expansion would confirm trend durability over the crowding caution; a failure to extend while breadth drops below 0.8 would retire the overweight lean.

theses.subject: Cybersecurity
theses.thesis: Cybersecurity is the strongest trend-quality theme in the detector: durability_bar 0.85 (highest of any eligible rank besides trend-tagged tech slices), hurst_tag 'trend' (persistent, not mixed), and breadth 1.0 (complete participation). Its rank momentum is a focus lens, not alpha, but the trend-gate leg is the one validated edge, and Cybersecurity passes the absolute-trend eligibility cleanly. Crowding (z=1.8) is high and is a size-down caution only, not a fade.
theses.dissent: Crowding_z of 1.8 is the highest in the eligible universe; attention spikes and crowded positioning often mark near-term tops, and the theme's own val_state proxy is not shown to be strengthening — high durability can persist while returns stall.

falsifier.text: CIBR underperforms SMH by more than 4% over any 10-session stretch before the 20-day check-by

theses.subject: AI Infrastructure
theses.thesis: AI Infrastructure is the ranked leader and headline theme, but the detector flags it as fading (val_state='fading') with a mixed hurst tag and only moderate durability (0.68). The trend-gate keeps it eligible, and it is NOT crowded (z=0.59), so the dominant narrative is not in blow-off territory. Lean overweight only as long as the trend gate holds; conviction is low because rank momentum is display-only and the theme's internal trend health is mixed rather than confirmed.
theses.dissent: The theme is fading in value state and its trend health is only mixed — leadership can persist in rank while the absolute-trend gate quietly breaks, and the rotation breadth is narrowing into a one-narrative structure that could unwind fast.

falsifier.text: SMH closes below its own 50-day moving average for more than 5 consecutive sessions before the 10-day check-by

theses.subject: US Energy Complex
theses.thesis: US Energy Complex ranks #4, passes the absolute-trend gate (eligible=true), and carries a 'trend' hurst tag with breadth 0.727 — a healthy, non-crowded trend (z=0.83) that is NOT part of the AI complex. It offers a different trend source while the dominant narrative stays narrow. The trend-gate leg is the one validated edge; momentum rank is only a focus signal.
theses.dissent: Energy is a macro-beta sector; if the broader risk regime shifts risk-off, the trend tag can flip quickly, and the theme has no unique catalyst in the state.

falsifier.text: XLE gives back more than 5% from the note date while SMH remains flat or positive over the next 15 sessions
